title: US · NHTSA owner complaints · Lexus ES (XZ10)
collector: luis (Claude Code research agents, run luis-competitors-2026-10-10)

sampling.method: NHTSA complaints API (complaintsByVehicle) for every NHTSA model name matching the vehicle, model years 2019-2025; all returned complaints, deduplicated by ODI number. Script: competitors/tools/nhtsa.py
sampling.query: make=LEXUS; model regex=^ES; exclude=$^; model years 2019-2025
limitations: Complaints are self-reported and almost all describe defects; volume scales with fleet size and age.
NHTSA model buckets are noisy (e.g. EQE sedan and SUV share buckets; complaints mentioning 'SUV' were dropped).
Narratives are NHTSA's published text (public domain); 17-character VIN-like tokens were replaced.
A complaint filed for several vehicles appears once per vehicle batch (dedup_key = ODI number + vehicle).

provenance.notes: Fetched directly from api.nhtsa.gov by competitors/tools/nhtsa.py; raw JSON kept in data/nhtsa/.

export_permissions.notes: Stored on branch luis-competitors by the collector's decision. External LLM use not decided by the team yet.
